inputs.text: On Sunday, March 29, BRS Working President KT Rama Rao accused the Congress government of failing to act on illegal mining and alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved. If public resources are being extracted by a company linked to a minister while the government looks away, that is a serious conflict-of-interest concern—not just a political squabble. Communities deserve transparent investigations and protection from powerful interests profiting at their expense.
